title: Resideo Grid Services and Enode expand access to residential energy flexibility
summary: Resideo Grid Services, a leading smart-home energy management provider in North America, and partner Enode will help utilities unlock more value from residential demand flexibility. The collaboration makes it easier to launch and scale programs that connect a wider range of home energy devices—including batteries, solar inverters, and EV chargers—while enabling homeowners to participate directly through their utility or energy provider’s existing platform. Together, Resideo Grid Services and Enode are making residential flexibility more accessible, impactful, and scalable than ever before.
